title: Enterprise Systems Architect
summary: Design high-concurrency modular adapters bridging legacy enterprise backends with reactive event streams.
description:
### Strategic Orientation

RHSP engineers modular software adapters that align disparate enterprise workflows. As an Enterprise Systems Architect, you will establish architectural boundaries, design scalable data trajectories, and resolve core structural friction for mission-critical platforms.

### Core Acumen

You will orchestrate systems across cloud infrastructure and on-premises perimeters, defining clear integration apertures without compromising security or operational velocity.
responsibilities: Architect resilient distributed pipelines and low-latency API adapters
Govern system design reviews and establish engineering standards across delivery teams
Model domain boundaries to insulate core banking and enterprise records from front-end volatility
Guide technical teams through complex integration milestones with precision
requirements: Demonstrated architectural leadership in distributed enterprise environments
Deep understanding of transactional integrity, event-driven designs, and telemetry pipelines
Fluency in TypeScript, Go, or Java alongside modern cloud ecosystems
Clear communication skills for articulating technical trade-offs to executive stakeholders

title: Lead Platform Engineer
summary: Construct internal developer platforms, automated delivery pipelines, and observability perimeters at scale.
description:
### Operational Scope

At RHSP, infrastructure is treated as an active mathematical surface. We build platform toolchains that enable rapid deployment cycles while maintaining strict compliance contours.

### Technical Mission

You will lead our platform operations group, ensuring zero-downtime rollouts, resilient container orchestration, and continuous telemetry monitoring across hybrid cloud deployments.
responsibilities: Construct and maintain sovereign Kubernetes clusters and CI/CD pipelines
Implement automated security boundaries and zero-trust networking perimeters
Design comprehensive telemetry dashboards for real-time latency and throughput tracking
Partner with product engineers to accelerate local development feedback loops
requirements: Hands-on mastery of Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, and Linux kernel internals
Proven track record governing mission-critical production infrastructure
Experience with Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and structured log aggregation
Rigorous mindset towards infrastructure-as-code and reproducible environments
